appUpdateAvailable: A new version is available. Reloading…
conflict: That conflicts with an existing record.
couldNotCopy: Couldn't copy — please select and copy manually.
forbidden: You don't have access to this.

pageNotFound.title: Page not found
pageNotFound.description: This page doesn't exist, or you don't have access to it.

rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
rateLimitedWithSeconds_one: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} second.
rateLimitedWithSeconds_other: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} seconds.
rootError: This page didn't load. Try again, or reload.
serverError: Something didn't work on our end. Try again in a moment.
sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Sign in again.

credential.account_not_found: That login account no longer exists.
credential.instance_not_found: That login instance no longer exists.
credential.lease_not_found: That lease no longer exists. It may have been released already; reload the lease list.
credential.definition_not_found: That definition version is not available (it may be archived).
credential.in_use: Every matching login instance is in use. Free one, add an instance, or try again later.
credential.account_paused: That login account is paused. Resume it or choose another account.
credential.needs_login: No matching login instance is ready. Log in or upload a value first.
credential.limit_reached: A login limit was reached (for example, too many login sessions at once).
credential.unavailable: CLI logins are not available on this server right now.
credential.repin_blocked: The definition version can't change while a sandbox uses this login or tokens still need recovering.
credential.repin_confirm_erase: This version change erases the stored proxied values; confirm it to continue.
credential.value_invalid: The value doesn't match the login's definition.
credential.definition_corrupt: The stored definition no longer matches its digest. Re-pin the login to a fresh version.
credential.busy: A sandbox or a login session is using it. Free it or wait, then try again.
credential.spec_too_large: The sandbox's logins are too large to install together. Use fewer logins.
credential.pending_drain: The login is still being freed. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
credential.recovery_required: Tokens from this sandbox still need to be recovered. Start the sandbox again, or force-release the lease on the login page.
credential.capture_in_progress: Tokens are being saved right now. Try again in a moment.
credential.capture_failed: Saving the tokens failed. Try again, or force-release the lease on the login page.
credential.host_forbidden: This login may not run on that host (it isn't yours and the login doesn't allow other hosts).
credential.env_conflict: Another attached login or the sandbox's own environment already sets one of this login's variables.
credential.path_conflict: Another attached login already uses one of this login's file paths.
credential.proxy_not_enabled: This sandbox wasn't created with the credential proxy, so it can't take a proxied login.
credential.not_attached: That login is not attached to this sandbox.
credential.already_attached: That login is already attached to this sandbox.
credential.login_needs_consent: No host of yours in that pool can run the login. Allow a host you don't own to continue.
credential.login_requires_upload: This login can't be set up in a login sandbox. Use Upload on the instance instead.
credential.login_state: The login session can't do that in its current state. Wait for it to update and try again.
